uart.signal: stock Arduino-ESP32 L0 (tests/fixtures/esp32s2-arduino-l0.elf) runs the genuine S2 mask ROM, ESP-IDF startup and FreeRTOS, and Serial.println writes 'LW_L0_OK' through UART_FIFO_AHB_REG (0x6000_0000, the PeriBus2 view of UART0 at 0x3F40_0000); the test asserts the console sink receives it, and a negative control with an erased partition table asserts it never does
uart.lane: core-ci / pr-workspace-tests: cargo test -p labwired-core --test esp esp32s2_arduino_boot::

spi.signal: stock Arduino-ESP32 L4 (tests/fixtures/esp32s2-arduino-l4.elf) clocks four bytes through GP-SPI2 (FSPI, 0x3F42_4000) with SPI.transfer and prints 'LW_L4_OK' only for the attached MAX31855's frame 0x01901600; the negative control without the device asserts MISO idles high (frame 0xffffffff) and no LW_L4_OK
spi.lane: core-ci / pr-workspace-tests: cargo test -p labwired-core --test esp esp32s2_arduino_spi::

i2c.signal: stock Arduino-ESP32 L3 (tests/fixtures/esp32s2-arduino-l3.elf) drives the I2C0 command list (0x3F41_3000): Wire writes the INA219 register pointer and requestFrom reads CONFIG 0x399F and BUS 0x19CA back; the test rejects an ACK-only pass, and the negative control without the device asserts the address is NACKed
i2c.lane: core-ci / pr-workspace-tests: cargo test -p labwired-core --test esp esp32s2_arduino_i2c::
